stories.title: Council apologises to Buckley estate left without bin collections since March
stories.summary: A Flintshire councillor has issued an unreserved apology to Buckley residents who have gone almost seven months without a bin collection. stories.title: Flintshire Cabinet accused of ‘party politics’ over £516k for Flintshire schools
